subject: Use V8 role-aware agent generation template for next Duo Open round
body: A new role-aware generation template has been published for the next round. It replaces drifting per-role prompt assumptions with one shared Artifactory/AgentBus bridge contract covering: current-spec/context procurement, DMSH/3 immutable presence, role-split recursive mesh behavior, append-only message generation, artifact publication, supersession, evidence-class/HEAD provenance, bounded research vs active Primary/Manager controllers, durable-evidence-first local cleanup, privacy minimization, and mandatory final closed-work reconciliation before Primary packaging. Use the ROLE field (PRIMARY / MANAGER_REVIEWER / RESEARCH) rather than forking separate coordination semantics.
